--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.productcosthistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the cost of a product over time.
Fields:
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The last date when this cost version was effective; after this date, a new cost superseded this record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when this cost record was last updated or modified in the system
  - standardcost (numeric): The monetary value representing the standard cost of the product during this effective period
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The first date when this cost version became effective and was used for valuation purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product for which this cost history record applies
Match reason: Source: vector

Domain: Product
Description: Cross-reference table mapping product models and illustrations.
Fields:
  - illustrationid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Identifier of the illustration such as a diagram, schematic, or photograph associated with the product model
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the product model illustration mapping was last modified
  - productmodelid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Identifier of the product model that the illustration represents

--- Table 3: adventureworks.sales.salespersonquotahistory ---
Domain: SalesQuota
Description: Sales performance tracking.
Fields:
  - quotadate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The date when the sales quota was set or became effective for the sales person
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when the quota record was last modified in the system
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the sales person to whom the quota is assigned
  - rowguid (uuid): A globally unique identifier assigned to each quota history record for internal reference
  - salesquota (numeric): The monetary sales target or goal set for the sales person during the quota period

  - cultureid (character(6)) [PK]: The standardized culture identifier code (e.g., en-US, es-MX) used to format dates, numbers, and currency for specific regions
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp recording when this language or culture record was last modified in the system

--- Table 6: adventureworks.production.productmodel ---
Domain: Product
Description: Product model classification.
Fields:
  - rowguid (uuid): System-generated globally unique identifier used for database replication, synchronization, and cross-reference across systems
  - name (character varying(50)): Business name of the product model used for identification, reporting, and association with manufactured products
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the product model record was last updated for audit and data quality tracking
  - productmodelid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique sequential identifier serving as the primary key to uniquely reference each product model in the system
  - catalogdescription (xml): XML document containing structured catalog content such as product features, specifications, and imagery for customer-facing display in sales channels
  - instructions (xml): XML document containing detailed manufacturing or assembly instructions, work specifications, and quality standards used by production teams

--- Table 7: adventureworks.production.productreview ---
Domain: Product Review
Description: Customer reviews of products they have purchased.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the review was last updated or edited
  - reviewername (character varying(50)): Name of the customer who submitted the review
  - emailaddress (character varying(50)): Email address of the reviewer for follow-up communications or verification
  - comments (character varying(3850)): Full text content of the customer's product feedback and experience description
  - productreviewid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each product review record
  - rating (integer(32,0)): Numeric rating value assigned to the product by the reviewer
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the product being reviewed

  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when this product-photo association was last updated for audit and synchronization purposes
  - productphotoid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key referencing the specific product photo record containing the actual image data and metadata

--- Table 9: adventureworks.sales.salesorderdetail ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Individual products associated with a specific sales order. See SalesOrderHeader.
Fields:
  - orderqty (smallint(16,0)): Number of units of the product ordered in this line item
  - unitpricediscount (numeric): Discount amount applied to the unit price, reducing the effective price per unit
  - unitprice (numeric): Standard selling price per unit for the product at time of order
  - carriertrackingnumber (character varying(25)): Shipping tracking number assigned by the carrier for this specific line item's shipment
  - rowguid (uuid): System-generated globally unique identifier used for database replication and synchronization
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the specific product being sold in this line item
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when this record was last updated in the system
  - salesorderdetailid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each line item in a sales order
  - specialofferid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to any promotional offer or discount program applied to this line item
  - salesorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Reference to the parent sales order this detail line belongs to

--- Table 10: adventureworks.purchasing.purchaseorderheader ---
Domain: Procurement
Description: General purchase order information. See PurchaseOrderDetail.
Fields:
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the purchase order was originally created and submitted to the vendor
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code representing the current lifecycle stage of the purchase order (e.g., pending, approved, received, closed)
  - vendorid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the vendor/supplier from whom goods or services are being procured
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this purchase order record
  - subtotal (numeric): Total monetary value of all line items before taxes, shipping, and other charges
  - employeeid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the employee who initiated or approved the purchase order
  - taxamt (numeric): Total tax amount applied to the purchase order based on applicable tax rates and jurisdictions
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier for the shipping carrier and method used (e.g., ground, express, freight)
  - revisionnumber (smallint(16,0)): Version indicator tracking the number of times this purchase order has been modified, enabling change history and audit trails
  - freight (numeric): Shipping and handling costs associated with transporting goods from vendor to organization
  - purchaseorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each purchase order, serving as the primary key for referencing and tracking individual orders
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the ordered goods were shipped or are scheduled to ship from the vendor
